title: Fable-Codex continuous agent loop: implement, test, independently review, and prepare for owner activation a durable continuous agent loop in which Fable 5/Claude Code is the sole producer, bounded subagents do scoped work under workload-first supervision without worker-visible token quotas, Codex is an external read-only supervisor/reviewer with a version-probed fail-closed transport, the owner has a no-duration one-command start plus durable status/ask/pause/resume/graceful-stop/emergency-stop controls and zero-context /loop-* terminal commands, continuity is a renewable sequence of bounded epochs with exact-once succession and crash/host-restart recovery, a narrowly allowlisted 4.8 guardrail bridge with a durable two-attempt cap, root-cause replace-not-layer repair gating, preserved graph/context intelligence, Fable-only GitHub effects under existing authority, and activation held behind the owner gate until a two-unit golden end-to-end readiness run from the exact owner start command passes without human continuation (revision 2026-08-24, workload-first subagent supervision).
